algorithm: random contiguous cortical parcel sampling in MNI152NLin2009cAsym 2mm, matched to the Wang25 ROI voxel count, restricted to a gray-matter cortical mask, EXCLUDING all Wang25 voxels
participant_statistic: E_subject computed per technically-valid participant with the FROZEN estimator
cohort_statistic: mean E_subject across the fixed evaluable denominator

inference.permutation: same within-pair content permutation as primary, applied to Wang25 and each random mask; n_perm=1000
inference.bootstrap: non-straddling hierarchical bootstrap of E, n_boot=1000
inference.multiple_comparison: random masks form the empirical null for E; one-sided p = fraction of random R_I >= Wang25 R_I (rank-based, inherently multiplicity-controlled)
inference.threshold: E>0 AND one-sided p<0.05 AND bootstrap CI lower>0

purpose: characterizes topographic specificity of any imagery reliability; reported alongside, never as, the primary C3XRP replication decision
